work.name: Cutoff for Random Walks on Dihedral Groups
work.summary: Preprint with Xiangying Huang on cutoff for random walks on finite dihedral groups.
highlights: Analyzed continuous-time Markov chains on random Cayley graphs of finite dihedral groups with k i.i.d. random generators
Proved high-probability cutoff in nearly the full regime 1 << log k << log |G|
Characterized the phase-dependent cutoff time and developed entropy-concentration estimates for auxiliary high-dimensional lattice processes with dependent coordinates

work.name: Columbia University Department of Statistics
work.summary: Research under Prof. Bodhisattva Sen on nonparametric maximum likelihood estimation for Gaussian/location mixture models.
highlights: Connected mixture-model likelihood geometry with convex-analytic arguments
Synthesized academic papers and monographs in weekly reports
Established optimizer existence and a finite-support representation via Caratheodory's theorem in likelihood-vector space

work.name: PolyMath Summer Research Program
work.summary: Collaborative research with Prof. Steven Miller on Benford's Law for digit-bias diagnostics.
highlights: Simulated precinct-level election profiles under Weibull models in R
Implemented chi-square goodness-of-fit tests and sensitivity analyses for digit-bias fraud-detection heuristics
